summary: Aflac Inc filed an 8-K to report the issuance of four tranches of senior notes totaling approximately $65.9 billion under an existing shelf registration statement. The notes comprise 2.117% notes due 2029, 2.802% notes due 2031, 3.123% notes due 2033, and 3.482% notes due 2036, each with standard redemption and interest payment terms. The proceeds are for general corporate purposes. The underwriting agreement includes customary provisions, with Mizuho, SMBC Nikko, Morgan Stanley, and MUFG as representatives. This is a routine debt offering by an issuer, not a special situation.
